info.title: Brack.Alltron EDI Services
info.description: Service that allows customers to submit EDI Orders

post.summary: Endpoint to submit new Brack.Alltron XML order

requestBody.description: Brack.Alltron XML order document (proprietary format, version 2.3x)

minimal-order.summary: Minimal order with one line item
minimal-order.value:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<order>
  <message_header source="L01" destination="20" accesscode="" test_flag="0" message_type="order" document_version_date="03.05.2005" document_version="2.30" generation_date="01.01.2024" generation_time="10:00:00" eMail_confirmation="orders@yourcompany.ch"/>
  <order_header>
    <order_reference>
      <BORN>PO-20240101-001</BORN>
      <BORD>01.01.2024</BORD>
    </order_reference>
    <order_party>
      <buyer_party>
        <party_id>
          <LPAN>A123456</LPAN>
        </party_id>
      </buyer_party>
      <ship_to_party>
        <party_id><LPAN/></party_id>
        <name_address>
          <PNA1>Max Mustermann</PNA1>
          <PNA2>Muster GmbH</PNA2>
          <PSTR>Musterstrasse 1</PSTR>
          <PPOB/>
          <PCTY>Zurich</PCTY>
          <PPOC>8001</PPOC>
          <PCTR>CH</PCTR>
        </name_address>
      </ship_to_party>
    </order_party>
    <order_information>
      <additional_information>
        <LNGC>G</LNGC>
        <SHCF>Y</SHCF>
      </additional_information>
    </order_information>
  </order_header>
  <order_body>
    <line_item_number>
      <BLIN>10000001</BLIN>
      <part_number>
        <LITM>1234567</LITM>
        <MITM/>
      </part_number>
      <quantity>
        <quantity_value><OQTY>2</OQTY></quantity_value>
      </quantity>
      <price><UPRC>49.95</UPRC></price>
    </line_item_number>
  </order_body>
</order>

400.description: Bad request. Content could be parsed, but data is invalid/incomplete.

401.description: Unauthorized. Authorization information is missing or invalid.

406.description: Not Acceptable. The provided body is not in the right format.
